packetName: Mark 4 TMI Hub Route Architecture and Safe Scaffold Specification
purpose: Documents the eight new local hub routes implemented in this pass (/about, /ecosystem, /consulting, /media, /performance, /distribution, /hero, /partners): a durable, restrained information architecture for texasmovement.com that does not claim any service, contact channel, commerce, membership, event, health guidance, legal advice, or operational offering is currently active.

infrastructureContext.note: Former tmi-* Cloudflare Pages projects are not present in the dashboard and are not treated as retained, available, deployed, or recoverable infrastructure anywhere in this document. This task made no Cloudflare, DNS, or deployment change of any kind.
infrastructureContext.architectureShiftFromVendoredConstants: packages/constants/src/ecosystem.ts (vendored @tmi/constants, NOT edited by this task) models an aspirational multi-repo ecosystem with one separate subdomain/repo per vertical (e.g. consulting.texasmovement.com as its own apps/consulting deployment). The owner's Mark 4 infrastructure direction supersedes that model operationally: exactly two canonical Cloudflare Pages projects exist today, and every new route in this task is a local PATH under texasmovement.com itself (e.g. /consulting), never a link to a *.texasmovement.com subdomain. None of the eight new pages renders PROPERTIES[key].url for any vertical; every internal link uses a local path string. This is flagged as a documentation-evidence note, not silently resolved by editing the vendored constants package (CLAUDE.md rule 7: never edit packages/constants/ speculatively).
